attributes.title: Level 3

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the order of the [set sprite to] blocks?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Which code block should be first? Why?

❓ What happens if you reorder the code blocks?


Solution: The food sprite’s [set sprite to] and [set sprite position to] blocks should be moved below the plate sprite’s code blocks.
steps.instructions:
When the direction buttons are pressed, the food sprite moves behind the plate sprite. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the food sprite appears in front of the plate sprite.

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the sprite name in the [move sprite with buttons] block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Which sprite do you want to move? 

❓How can you change your code to make this happen? 


Solution: Click the ⏷on the [mySprite] bubble on the [move sprite with buttons] code block to select the taco sprite.
steps.instructions:
When the direction buttons are pressed, the plate sprite moves instead of the taco sprite.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the taco sprite moves instead of the plate sprite.
